entities.name: Draktha
entities.description: Manipulative green-skinned black mage, duelist of Thorun on Mirrankkar.

entities.name: Thorun
entities.description: Town on Mirrankkar that became the largest city thanks to Draktha's victories.

events.summary: Draktha demands the king's next child as payment for the coming contest; the king refuses and Draktha teleports away.
events.quote: Draktha urged him to rethink or rot before teleporting away
